title: Use a local image
summary: Image displays a native picture. A local file can be bundled with require so the app can include it at build time.
introduction: Image displays a native picture. A local file can be bundled with require so the app can include it at build time. Your task: Add a real local image and choose a useful description.
learningObjectives: Add a real local image and choose a useful description.
Explain the example for use a local image

blocks.text: Image displays a native picture. A local file can be bundled with require so the app can include it at build time.
Use a current Expo project with React Native. Put examples in App.jsx. Run the project with Expo on a supported device or emulator. Native components do not run in this website's HTML playground.

blocks.code:
import {View,Image} from "react-native";
export default function App(){return <View style={{padding:24}}><Image source={require("./assets/garden.png")} style={{width:160,height:120}} accessibilityLabel="Our school garden"/></View>;}
blocks.title: Use a local image

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: require identifies a real asset to bundle with the app.
The native style chooses the image display size; the accessibility label describes its information.

blocks.text: After adding a real garden.png file, the app shows it at the chosen size.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: The required file must exist. Use an image description when it carries information.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Add a real local image and choose a useful description.
